column4: dialect-gated: single CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL gate, one skip, no subtest split (a second source skip site guards testing.Short(), which does not fire in this job). New in cleat#2890/PR #2903, added after cleat-review (G1) found the test FATALs instead of skipping in this PostgreSQL-only job (testutil.MSSQLTestDB does not skip on an unset DSN, it defaults and fails loud). Measured: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL CLEAT_TEST_DB=<pg> go test ./plugins/kvstore/... -run '^TestConcurrentMergesToABrandNewKeyRaceWithoutHoldlock$' -count=1 -json | grep -c '"Action":"skip"' reports 1.
